channel.title: ResponderTX · Flood Ops
channel.description: Flood warnings, watches and advisories, flash flood emergencies, forecast river crests, and active notices for Texas. Situational awareness, not a dispatch system; call 911 for emergencies.

item.title: Coastal Flood Advisory · Aransas Islands, Kleberg Islands, Nueces Islands, Calhoun Islands
item.description: Coastal Flood Advisory issued October 6 at 1:50AM CDT until October 6 at 7:00PM CDT by NWS Corpus Christi TX. In effect until Oct 6, 7:00 PM CT. Areas: Aransas Islands, Kleberg Islands, Nueces Islands, Calhoun Islands. Source: National Weather Service. Call 911 for life-threatening emergencies.
